before-the-queen-of-thieves.npc: Greetings. What can I do for you?

steps.npc: I'm conducting important business here for the Kourend Council.

steps.player: Is there anything I can help you with?

steps.npc: There is something I could use some help with. I'm here on behalf of the Kourend Council to investigate some unusual happenings in Port Piscarilius.
Port Piscarilius is home to various gangs. They're a nuisance, but up until now we haven't had much trouble in dealing with them.
A new gang calling themselves the Saviours of Kourend has recently formed. That's not surprising as gangs come and go all of the time, but this one is different.
The Saviours of Kourend have been absorbing many of the other gangs. Within a few weeks they've already become the largest gang in Kourend and more join them each day.
The talk amongst the people is that it's all down to their leader, a mysterious figure known only as the Queen of Thieves.

steps.player: Nice name. Why doesn't the ruler of Port Piscarilius do something about this?

steps.npc: Shauna Piscarilius is the ruler of Port Piscarilius, but she spends most of her time galavanting around in that boat of hers rather than looking after her home.

steps.player: Fair enough. So what do you need me for?

steps.npc: Well my original plan was to infiltrate the gang to get close to the Queen and capture her. However, I've been unable to make any progress. Apparently, I don't look the part.

steps.player: Yeah not sure what that's all about. You clearly fit right in here.

steps.npc: Quite right. They're quite insistent though, so someone else will need to give it a go. You look like you might be just the type they're after.

steps.player: What are you trying to say?

steps.npc: That you look poor.
Anyway if you're up for the task you'll need to infiltrate the Saviours of Kourend, find the Queen of Thieves, apprehend her and then bring her to me.
So are you up for it?

steps.text: The Queen of Thieves has been started.

steps.npc: Excellent. The Saviours of Kourend must have their headquarters somewhere nearby. You should ask around town and see if anyone knows where they are. Good luck.
Fair enough. I'll be here if you change your mind.
Although it's called a kingdom, Great Kourend hasn't actually had a king for many years. These days Kourend is a republic and it is ruled by the Kourend Council.
The Council consists of four councillors who are elected by the people every four years. The current councillors are Councillor Hughes, Councillor Unkar, Councillor Orson and Councillor Andrews.

steps.player: I see. So what are you investigating?

steps.npc: Port Piscarilius is home to various gangs. They're a nuisance, but up until now we haven't had much trouble in dealing with them.

steps.text: If the player does not have the requirements to start The Queen of Thieves:

steps.npc: Well there is something I could use some help with. However, you're not really the person I need for this task.

steps.text: If the player does have the requirements to start The Queen of Thieves:

steps.npc: Well there is something I could use some help with. I'm here on behalf of the Kourend Council to investigate some unusual happenings in Port Piscarilius.
Very well. Until next time.

during-the-queen-of-thieves-before-findi.npc: Greetings. What can I do for you?

during-the-queen-of-thieves-after-findin.npc: Greetings. What can I do for you?

steps.npc: Very well. How goes things?

steps.player: I haven't had any luck finding the Queen of Thieves. However, I've come across this letter which you might find interesting.

steps.npc: Blimey! Forget the Queen of Thieves. If this letter is to be believed, Councillor Hughes is working with those vile Disciples of Yama. I must report this to the council immediately.

options.text: Great! So can I have a reward?

steps.player: Great! So can I have a reward?

steps.npc: You've done a great service to the people of Kourend. As I'm sure you know, there is no greater reward than the satisfaction of a job well done.
Now be on your way. I have a lot of work to do.

options.text: What do you know of the Disciples of Yama?

steps.player: What do you know of the Disciples of Yama?

steps.npc: They're a group of deranged cultists that worship some sort of demon. They're not a big threat compared to the lizardmen, but they're still an enemy to Kourend.

steps.player: And Councillor Hughes is helping them? That's not good.

steps.npc: Indeed. I must report this to the Council immediately.

steps.player: So can I have a reward?

steps.npc: You've done a great service to the people of Kourend. As I'm sure you know, there is no greater reward than the satisfaction of a job well done.
Now be on your way. I have a lot of work to do.

after-the-queen-of-thieves-and-before-a-.npc: Very well thank you. My work in bringing down Councillor Hughes means that I'm finally starting to get the recognition that I deserve.
Yes, yes, very good job. I'll make sure to mention you in my acceptance speech when I'm voted in as her replacement.

after-completing-a-kingdom-divided.npc: I'm ruined. Everything was perfect under the Council, but now I'm right back in the dirt again.

after-completing-a-kingdom-divided.player: You were very close to the Council. You should be glad you got to keep your job at all.

after-completing-a-kingdom-divided.npc: But I didn't keep my job. Now I spend every day doing boring administrative work. It's a nightmare.

after-completing-a-kingdom-divided.player: Come now Tomas, it can't be all bad. Show a little enthusiasm.
